_help: Edit this file to change which eye/mouth image each emotion uses, which depth each accessory sits at, and the zoom presets. Names are file names without .png.
_slots_help: Accessory depths, bottom to top: back (behind everything), behind-body (above back hair, behind the body), behind-front-hair (above face, behind front hair), top (above everything, the default). An accessory can also get its depth just by living in accessories/<slot>/ ; entries below win over folders.
